name: GGH15
title: gamma-GGH15 encodings (CVW18 Construction 5.1) and concrete-security closeness
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.GGH15: the gamma-GGH15 encoding of Chen-Vaikuntanathan-Wee (CRYPTO 2018, ePrint 2018/360, Construction 5.1) with row-indexed level matrices A_0..A_h in Z_q^{t x m}, ideal trapdoor sampling (uniform A_0..A_{h-1}, D_{i,b} from the coset Gaussian Trapdoor.preimage of S_{i,b} A_i + E_{i,b}, E from D_{Z,chi}), subset products along paths, the gamma functions gamma_tensor, gamma_diag, gamma_tensor-diag, bit encodings of views, and CloseAt D0 D1 k L W: every machine has 2^k * gain <= L^2 * (cost + W) (Problem.HardAt with an explicit loss).
